summary: 27-year-old man visiting from Virginia accidentally fell ~400 ft from near Cold Shivers Point Overlook; NPS and Mesa County Sheriff personnel conducted the body recovery.
responding_agency: NPS rangers; Mesa County Sheriff's Office
notes: One of three separate September-2013 visitor fatalities reported by the park; the other two were a 9/9 suicide and a 9/18-19 single-vehicle crash.
